verdict.rationale: Kong documents an AI Gateway that proxies LLM traffic through a provider-agnostic API across OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini and others. It enforces rate limits, guardrails, semantic security and DLP/toxicity policies, and an MCP Traffic Gateway covers MCP governance, security and observability. Missing for 10: explicit token-based limit documentation (the evidence only mentions generic rate limits and cost control), specifics of the prompt-guard features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these AI governance features.
